title: Leave notes with comments
objective: Write notes that Lagom skips when the program runs.

body.text: A line that starts with # is a comment. Lagom skips comments, so you can use them to explain the code to a reader.

body.title: Comments are skipped
body.code:
# This line is a comment. Lagom skips it.
say "Comments are skipped"
## Two hashes (##) mark a doc comment.
say "Done"

body.text: Both # and ## comments are ignored when the program runs. Use comments to explain why the code does something, not to repeat what each word says.
Task: add a comment above each say line in the example, then press Run. The output should not change.
